Promise: Those who receive abundance of grace and the gift of righteousness will reign in life through Jesus Christ.
Condition: Receiving abundance of grace and the gift of righteousness

Title: Creation Set Free
Promise: Creation itself will be set free from bondage to decay into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

Title: Every Knee Shall Bow
Promise: Every knee will bow and every tongue will confess to God, acknowledging the lordship of Jesus Christ.

Title: Confirmed to the End
Promise: God will confirm believers to the end so they stand blameless on the day of Christ, because God who called them into fellowship with his Son is faithful.

Title: Things Prepared for Those Who Love Him
Promise: God has prepared things for those who love him that eye has not seen, ear has not heard, and no human heart has imagined.
Condition: Loving God

Title: Reward for Faithful Work
Promise: Faithful work that endures will receive its reward from the Lord, including the reward of the inheritance for service done for Christ, and even a cup of water given in his name will not lose its reward.
Condition: Faithful work and service
KeyScriptures: 1 Corinthians 3:14; Colossians 3:24; Mark 9:41; Hebrews 10:35; Revelation 11:18; Revelation 22:12

Title: A Way of Escape
Promise: God is faithful and will not allow believers to be tempted beyond what they can bear, but will provide a way of escape so they can endure it.

Title: An Eternal House in Heaven
Promise: If the earthly tent of this life is taken down, believers have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

Title: God Dwelling Among His People
Promise: God will dwell among his people and walk with them, being their God and their Father, and they will be his sons and daughters.

Title: All Grace Abounding
Promise: God is able to make all grace abound to believers, so that having all sufficiency in all things they may abound in every good work.

Title: Grace Sufficient in Weakness
Promise: Christ's grace is sufficient for believers, and his strength is made perfect in weakness.

Title: Heirs According to the Promise
Promise: Those who belong to Christ are Abraham's seed and heirs according to the promise, fellow heirs with Israel and partakers of the same promise in Christ.
Condition: Belonging to Christ

Title: Sealed with the Spirit of Promise
Promise: Believers who trust in Christ are sealed with the promised Holy Spirit, the guarantee of their inheritance until the redemption of God's possession.
Condition: Believing and trusting in Christ

Title: Wellbeing and Long Life for Honouring Parents
Promise: Honouring father and mother brings wellbeing and long life on the earth, the first commandment with a promise.
Condition: Honouring father and mother

Title: The Good Work Completed
Promise: God who began a good work in believers will bring it to completion by the day of Jesus Christ.

Title: Transformed Bodies Like His
Promise: At Christ's coming, he will transform believers' lowly bodies to be like his glorious body, by the power that subjects all things to himself.

Title: Not Appointed to Wrath
Promise: God has not appointed believers to wrath but to obtain salvation through Jesus Christ, who delivers them from the wrath to come.

Title: Sanctified Wholly and Preserved Blameless
Promise: The God of peace will sanctify believers wholly, spirit, soul, and body, and preserve them blameless at the coming of Christ, because he who calls them is faithful and will do it.

Title: Rest at the Revelation of Christ
Promise: To believers who are troubled, God will give rest at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with his mighty angels.

Title: Promise for This Life and the Next
Promise: Godliness is profitable for all things, carrying promise for the life that now is and for the life to come.

Title: Reigning with Christ
Promise: If believers die with Christ they will live with him, and if they suffer with him they will reign with him.
Condition: Suffering with Christ

Title: A Crown of Righteousness
Promise: A crown of righteousness awaits all who love Christ's appearing, given by the righteous Judge on that day.
Condition: Loving Christ's appearing

Title: Mercy and Grace at the Throne
Promise: Those who come boldly to the throne of grace will obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need.
Condition: Coming boldly to the throne of grace

Title: The Promise of the Eternal Inheritance
Promise: Through Christ, the mediator of the new covenant, those who are called receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
Condition: Being among the called

Title: A Kingdom That Cannot Be Moved
Promise: After the final shaking of heaven and earth, believers receive a kingdom that cannot be moved, and so worship God acceptably with reverence.

Title: A City Prepared
Promise: God is not ashamed to be called the God of those who desire a heavenly country, for he has prepared a city for them.
Condition: Desiring a heavenly country

Title: The Crown of Life
Promise: The one who endures temptation and is approved will receive the crown of life, which the Lord has promised to those who love him.
Condition: Enduring temptation and loving God

Title: Heirs of the Kingdom
Promise: God has chosen the poor of this world, rich in faith, to be heirs of the kingdom he promised to those who love him.
Condition: Being poor in the world and rich in faith, loving God

Title: Draw Near, and He Will Draw Near
Promise: If believers draw near to God, he will draw near to them.
Condition: Drawing near to God

Title: Lifted Up for Humbling Oneself
Promise: Whoever humbles himself in the sight of the Lord will be lifted up in due time.
Condition: Humbling oneself before the Lord

Title: An Inheritance Reserved in Heaven
Promise: Believers have an inheritance that is incorruptible, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for them and guarded by God's power through faith for salvation ready to be revealed.

Title: The Lord's Eyes on the Righteous
Promise: The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and his ears are open to their prayers, while his face is against those who do evil.

Title: An Unfading Crown of Glory
Promise: When the chief Shepherd appears, faithful shepherds of God's flock will receive a crown of glory that never fades.
Condition: Shepherding God's flock willingly and by example

Title: He Cares for You
Promise: Believers may cast all their cares on God, because he cares for them.
Condition: Casting all anxieties on him

Title: Perfected, Established, Strengthened, Settled
Promise: After believers have suffered a little while, the God of all grace who called them to eternal glory in Christ will himself perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle them.

Title: Partakers of the Divine Nature
Promise: Through God's exceedingly great and precious promises, believers partake of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption in the world through desire.

Title: An Abundant Entrance
Promise: Believers who diligently practise these qualities will never stumble, and an entrance into the everlasting kingdom of Christ will be richly supplied to them.
Condition: Diligence in faith, virtue, knowledge, self-control, patience, godliness, brotherly kindness, and love

Title: Like Him When He Appears
Promise: When Christ appears, believers will be like him, seeing him as he is, and will appear with him in glory with confidence and without shame.

Title: Blessing on Readers and Keepers
Promise: Blessing rests on those who read, hear, and keep the words of this prophecy, for the time is near.
Condition: Reading, hearing, and keeping the words of the prophecy

Title: The Tree of Life
Promise: To the one who overcomes, Christ will give to eat from the tree of life in the midst of the paradise of God.
Condition: Overcoming

Title: Crown of Life and No Hurt from the Second Death
Promise: The one who is faithful even to death will receive the crown of life and will not be hurt by the second death.
Condition: Faithfulness even to death

Title: Hidden Manna and a White Stone
Promise: To the one who overcomes, Christ will give hidden manna and a white stone with a new name written on it, known only to the one who receives it.
Condition: Overcoming

Title: Authority and the Morning Star
Promise: To the one who overcomes and keeps Christ's works to the end, he will give authority over the nations and the morning star.
Condition: Overcoming and keeping Christ's works to the end

Title: White Garments and a Name Confessed
Promise: The one who overcomes will be clothed in white garments, and Christ will not blot his name from the book of life but will confess it before the Father and his angels.
Condition: Overcoming

Title: A Pillar and a New Name
Promise: The one who overcomes will be made a pillar in the temple of God, never to leave it, bearing the name of God, the name of the New Jerusalem, and Christ's new name.
Condition: Overcoming

Title: A Seat on Christ's Throne
Promise: To the one who overcomes, Christ will grant to sit with him on his throne, as he overcame and sat down with the Father on his throne.
Condition: Overcoming

Title: Christ Comes In and Sups
Promise: If anyone hears Christ's voice and opens the door, he will come in and share a meal with them, and they with him.
Condition: Hearing Christ's voice and opening the door

Title: Rest from Labours
Promise: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on, for they rest from their labours and their works follow them.
Condition: Dying in the Lord

Title: Called to the Marriage Supper
Promise: Blessed are those who are called to the marriage supper of the Lamb.

Title: Right to the Tree of Life and Entry Through the Gates
Promise: Those who keep his commandments have the right to the tree of life and may enter through the gates into the city, where the river of life flows and the tree bears fruit every month with leaves for the healing of the nations.
Condition: Keeping his commandments

Title: Water of Life Freely and All Things Inherited
Promise: To the thirsty, God will give freely from the spring of the water of life, and the one who overcomes will inherit all things, with God as his God and himself as God's son.
Condition: Thirsting; overcoming

Title: The Kingdoms Become Christ's
Promise: The kingdoms of this world will become the kingdoms of the Lord and of his Christ, and he will reign for ever and ever.

Title: Priests Who Reign with Christ
Promise: Those who share in the first resurrection are blessed and holy; the second death has no power over them, and they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with him, serving him and reigning for ever and ever.
Condition: Sharing in the first resurrection

Title: Signs Following Believers
Promise: believers will be accompanied by signs, including speaking in new tongues, taking up serpents unharmed, and healing the sick by laying on of hands. Doubt: stands in the longer ending of Mark, whose textual status is debated; the promise of signs (new tongues, serpents, healing) is otherwise unattested in the NT.

Title: Possessing Your Souls by Patience
Promise: by patient endurance believers possess their souls. Doubt: phrased as an outcome of endurance but reads as wisdom counsel as much as a divine commitment; kept out of the main array on that ambiguity.

Title: Paul's Protection in Corinth
Promise: the Lord would be with Paul in Corinth and no one would set on him to hurt him. Doubt: a personal, time-bound assurance to Paul in Corinth (no one would attack him there), not a standing promise to believers generally.

Title: Paul Must Stand Before Caesar
Promise: Paul would stand before Caesar and all sailing with him would be spared. Doubt: a personal assurance to Paul that he must stand before Caesar and that all aboard would be preserved for his sake; time-bound and individual.

Title: Deliverance and Preservation to the Heavenly Kingdom
Promise: the Lord would deliver Paul from every evil work and preserve him unto his heavenly kingdom. Doubt: Paul's personal confidence about his own end; general application is traditional rather than explicit in the verse.

Title: Equipped for Every Good Work
Promise: the God of peace would equip believers in every good work to do his will, working in them what is wellpleasing to him. Doubt: benediction/prayer form (a wish that God would make readers perfect), not a direct promise statement.

Title: Truth With Us for Ever
Promise: the truth dwells in believers and will be with them for ever. Doubt: a statement about truth dwelling in believers and remaining with them for ever; arguably a promise of truth's permanence, but not framed as a divine commitment.

Title: An Incorruptible Crown
Promise: unlike athletes who run for a corruptible crown, believers run for one that does not decay. Doubt: athletic metaphor; states believers run for an incorruptible crown but gives no direct 'I will give' commitment.

Title: Saved in Childbearing
Promise: the woman will be saved in childbearing if they continue in faith, love, holiness, and sobriety. Doubt: meaning heavily debated (saved through childbearing, or preserved through it); the condition and the sense of 'saved' are both uncertain.
